filters.FAIL_MANUAL_REVIEW: Low-quality variant that did not pass manual review of supporting evidence
filters.HIGH_NCR: Unacceptably high rate of no-call GTs
filters.IGH_MHC_OVERLAP: SVs that are overlapped by over 50% by IGH or MCH regions, these variants are of low confidence
filters.LOWQUAL_WHAM_SR_DEL: deletions under1Kb that are uniquely from wham and have SR-only support
filters.OUTLIER_SAMPLE_ENRICHED: SVs that are enriched for non-reference genotypes in outlier samples, likely indicating noisy or unreliable genotypes
filters.REDUNDANT_LG_CNV: Multiple large CNVs called at the same locus likely indicates unreliable clustering and/or low-quality multiallelic locus
filters.REFERENCE_ARTIFACT: Likely reference artifact sites that are homozygous alternative in over 99% of the samples

BOTHSIDES_SUPPORT.description: Variant has read-level support for both sides of breakpoint.Indicates higher-confidence variants.

END.description: End position of the structural variant

END2.description: End position of the structural variant on CHR2

LOW_CONFIDENCE_REPETITIVE_LARGE_DUP.description: Duplications over 5Kb that are overlapped by segmental duplicates or simple repeats, these variants are not as high confident as others because of the affect by the repetitive sequences

OUTLIER_SAMPLE_ENRICHED_LENIENT.description: SVs that are enriched for non-reference genotypes in outlier samples (10%), likely indicating noisy or unreliable genotypes

PCRMINUS_NCR.description: Proportion of no-call GTs in PCRMINUS samples

PCRPLUS_NCR.description: Fraction of PCRPLUS sample GTs that are no-calls.

PESR_GT_OVERDISPERSION.description: PESR genotyping data is overdispersed. Flags sites where genotypes are likely noisier.

POS2.description: Start position of the structural variant on CHR2

PREDICTED_BREAKEND_EXONIC.description: Gene(s) for which the SV breakend is predicted to fall in an exon.

PREDICTED_COPY_GAIN.description: Gene(s) on which the SV is predicted to have a copy-gain effect.

PREDICTED_DUP_PARTIAL.description: Gene(s) which are partially overlapped by an SV's duplication, but the transcription start site is not duplicated.

PREDICTED_INTERGENIC.description: SV does not overlap any protein-coding genes.

PREDICTED_INTRAGENIC_EXON_DUP.description: Gene(s) on which the SV is predicted to result in intragenic exonic duplication without breaking any coding sequences.

PREDICTED_INTRONIC.description: Gene(s) where the SV was found to lie entirely within an intron.

PREDICTED_INV_SPAN.description: Gene(s) which are entirely spanned by an SV's inversion.

PREDICTED_LOF.description: Gene(s) on which the SV is predicted to have a loss-of-function effect.

PREDICTED_MSV_EXON_OVERLAP.description: Gene(s) on which the multiallelic SV would be predicted to have a LOF, INTRAGENIC_EXON_DUP, COPY_GAIN, DUP_PARTIAL, TSS_DUP, or PARTIAL_EXON_DUP annotation if the SV were biallelic.

PREDICTED_NEAREST_TSS.description: Nearest transcription start site to an intergenic variant.

PREDICTED_NONCODING_BREAKPOINT.description: Class(es) of noncoding elements disrupted by SV breakpoint.

PREDICTED_NONCODING_SPAN.description: Class(es) of noncoding elements spanned by SV.

PREDICTED_PARTIAL_DISPERSED_DUP.description: Gene(s) overlapped partially by the duplicated interval involved in a dispersed duplication event in a complex SV.

PREDICTED_PARTIAL_EXON_DUP.description: Gene(s) where the duplication SV has one breakpoint in the coding sequence.

PREDICTED_PROMOTER.description: Gene(s) for which the SV is predicted to overlap the promoter region.

PREDICTED_TSS_DUP.description: Gene(s) for which the SV is predicted to duplicate the transcription start site.

PREDICTED_UTR.description: Gene(s) for which the SV is predicted to disrupt a UTR.

RESOLVED_POSTHOC.description: SVs that are manually resolved posthoc.
